cond_0164.intro: We are looking for a Test Engineer to join our team.
cond_0164.responsibilities:
Provide test engineering for facility. Support Test Engineering function by providing guidance and support to other test engineers. Troubleshoot test fixtures, software, and procedures.
Perform analysis, diagnostics and preliminary evaluations of products; develop testing procedures and fixtures as required
Develop test procedures, equipment and fixturing design responsibilities
Analyze customer requirements and develop testing procedures
Repair and maintenance of test fixtures
Install test software, programming software and repair test PCs
Repairing and troubleshooting test PCs
Assist Production with test needs and troubleshooting PCA down to the component
Work on and set up Engineering VLAN
cond_0164.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a related technical field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in a progressive, relevant technical role.
Deep knowledge of analog and digital electronic circuits and theory.
Proven track record troubleshooting down to the component level for analog, digital, and embedded circuits/systems.
Strong command of electronic test equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, 4-wire LCR meters, etc.
Advanced ability to read schematics, wiring diagrams, and engineering drawings.
Expertise in PC hardware, OS systems, and installing and working with test software.
Exceptional technical writing and documentation skills.
Solid understanding of LAN/WAN networking technologies, including Ethernet and TCP/IP.
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and/or other drafting applications.
Solid understanding of mechanical systems.
Expertise in schematic capture and electrical design.
Substantial soldering skills, including rework with through-hole and SMT components.
Ability to build prototypes and wire systems.
Strong command of MS Office applications (Word, Excel, and Outlook).
Exceptional communication skills across all forms, with internal and external stakeholders.
Proven ability to provide solutions to complex problems, plan effectively, resolve issues, and establish priorities.
Ability to work with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to multitask and adapt within a rapidly changing environment.

Provide test engineering for facility. Support Test Engineering function by providing guidance and support to other test engineers. Troubleshoot test fixtures, software, and procedures.
Perform analysis, diagnostics and preliminary evaluations of products; develop testing procedures and fixtures as required
Develop test procedures, equipment and fixturing design responsibilities
Analyze customer requirements and develop testing procedures
Repair and maintenance of test fixtures
Install test software, programming software and repair test PCs
Repairing and troubleshooting test PCs
Assist Production with test needs and troubleshooting PCA down to the component
Work on and set up Engineering VLAN
cond_0318.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 5 years of progressive relevant job experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Some background in technical writing.
Experience with PC hardware, OS systems, and installing and working with test software.
Comfort reading schematics and wiring diagrams.
Working knowledge of schematic capture and electrical design.
Familiarity with mechanical systems.
Background in analog and digital electronic circuits and theory.
Experience using electronic test equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, 4-wire LCR meters, etc.
Ability to troubleshoot down to the component level for analog, digital, and embedded circuits/systems.
Familiarity with SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and/or other drafting applications.
Exposure to LAN/WAN networking technologies, including Ethernet and TCP/IP.
Experience with technical writing and documentation.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings.
Ability to troubleshoot PC hardware.
Soldering skills, including rework with through-hole and SMT components.
Ability to build prototypes and wire systems.
Working knowledge of MS Office applications (Word, Excel, and Outlook).
Willingness to communicate effectively in all forms with others inside and outside the organization.
Openness to working through complex problems and developing solutions.
Ability to plan, resolve problems, and establish priorities.
Attention to detail and commitment to producing quality results.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt as priorities shift.

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of analog and digital electronic systems and test processes.
cond_0571.responsibilities:
Perform analysis, diagnostics and preliminary evaluations of products; develop testing procedures and fixtures as required
Develop test procedures, equipment and fixturing design responsibilities
Analyze customer requirements and develop testing procedures
Repair and maintenance of test fixtures
Install test software, programming software and repair test PCs
Repairing and troubleshooting test PCs
Assist Production with test needs and troubleshooting PCA down to the component
Work on and set up Engineering VLAN
cond_0571.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in related technical field
Minimum 5 years of progressive relevant job experience
Previous experience with technical writing
Previous experience with PC hardware, OS system, and installing and working with test software
Advanced ability to read schematics and wiring diagrams
Intermediate ability in schematic capture and electrical design
Intermediate knowledge of mechanical systems
Advanced knowledge of analog and digital electronic circuits and theory
Advanced knowledge using electronic test equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzer, 4wire LCR meters etc.
Advanced ability to troubleshoot down to the component level for both analog, digital, and embedded circuits/systems
Proficient with Solid Works, AutoCAD and/or other drafting applications
Knowledge of LAN/WAN networking technologies, including Ethernet and TCP/IP
Advanced technical writing and documentation skills
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings
Ability to troubleshoot PC hardware
Soldering skills, rework with through hole and SMT components
Ability to build prototypes and wire systems
Intermediate level in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, and Outlook)
Ability to effectively communicate in all forms with others inside and outside the organization
Ability to provide solutions to complex problems
Ability to plan, resolve problems effectively, and establish priorities
Ability to work with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail to produce quality results
Ability to multitask efficiently and adapt within a rapidly changing environment
